description: This file defines the StripeManager class which manages interactions with the Stripe API, including subscription management, product and feature retrieval, customer portal session creation, and plan updates, with special handling for free trial coupons and proration calculations.

classes.name: StripeManager
classes.description: A singleton class that handles Stripe API interactions for subscription management, product features, customer portal sessions, and plan updates, including handling coupons and proration.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of StripeManager, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Stripe client with the secret key and sets up the cache manager.

methods.name: getStripe
methods.description: Returns the Stripe client instance, throws error if not initialized.

methods.name: getSubscriptionObject
methods.description: Extracts and returns basic subscription details: customer, status, created.

methods.name: getProductIdFromSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves the product ID associated with a subscription, using cache if available.

methods.name: getFeaturesByPlan
methods.description: Fetches features metadata for a subscription's product, with optional cache usage.

methods.name: createStripeCustomerPortalSession
methods.description: Creates a billing portal session for customer account management.

methods.name: getPriceIds
methods.description: Retrieves active price IDs for different user plans and seat options.

methods.name: createPortalConfiguration
methods.description: Creates billing portal configuration with enabled features.

methods.name: getAdditionalSeatsQuantity
methods.description: Retrieves the quantity of additional seats and included seats for a subscription.

methods.name: getCustomerWithDefaultSource
methods.description: Retrieves customer details including default payment source.

methods.name: getAdditionalSeatsProration
methods.description: Calculates proration details for additional seats when quantity changes.

methods.name: updateAdditionalSeats
methods.description: Updates the quantity of additional seats and pays the invoice if unpaid.

methods.name: getPlanProration
methods.description: Calculates proration details when changing to a new plan, including first month free eligibility.

methods.name: updateSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Updates a subscription to a new plan, applying a first-month-free coupon if eligible, and pays the latest invoice.
